author: Gauldron
quote:
Jorunalists and "professionals" exaggerated with the possitive reviews, so now it is time for gamers to rise up and exaggerate with the negative ones. Although, unlike journalists, at least I am going to be my honest thoughts on the game: 

Possitive aspects:
Sandbox, graphics, and overall game presentation is top notch. The attention to detail is insane. For a lot of people the fact that it runs at 30 fps is a deal breaker, but for me it is really not that bad. It would work really well as a fun GTA game If it wasnt for...

Negative aspects: 
Characters are boring and sanitized, humor is not funny and dialogue is abysmal, which is a crime for a GTA game. You can just tell it was written by women. The game limits you a lot in what you can and cant do depending on the area and characters involved, which again, is a crime for a GTA game in which the MAIN appeal is being able to do whatever you want. There is also a lot of emphasis on the relationship between Jason and Lucia, and I just have to ask why? I am not playing GTA to play a dating sim, I have an annoying girlfriend in real life, I dont need a virtual one too. It just feels really lame to have to do these mundane relationshilp stuff in my male fantasy crime game. And yes, fair enough, this is mostly at the beginning of the game, but that is the most important part to hook the player and it doesnt do a good job at all.
